title: Teeth that pass like blades
hook: Chewing surfaces need not all meet flat.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The two pointed edges pass beside one another in the simplified drawing, like shears. Carnassial teeth in many carnivorans have edges suited to cutting; the schematic does not show all tooth positions or a measured bite.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: Which pictured motion best represents a shearing pair of carnassial teeth?
